## Project Code Patterns
- domain-owned-ports — Define narrow consumer-owned interfaces and adapt infrastructure or sibling domains behind them.
- generated-protobuf-contracts — Generate committed Rust and TypeScript wire artifacts from `.proto`; never hand-edit generated output.
- registry-derived-protocol-boundaries — Parse, constrain, and dispatch canonical generated enums at every receiving boundary.
- fail-fast-boundary-validation — Reject malformed framing, missing required fields, and unknown values before stateful work or durable append.
- durable-log-projections — Rebuild each in-memory view by folding its authority-domain log in validated LSN order.
- presentation-registry-conformance — Bind every protocol state registry to checked CSS and showcase primitives without inventing states.

Load the `patterns` skill (read `.agents/skills/patterns/<slug>.md`) for full
rationale, examples, and common violations.
